name: Open-LLM-Leaderboard
description: Open-LLM-Leaderboard is a new evaluation benchmark for large language models that shifts from multiple-choice questions to open-style questions to reduce selection bias and random guessing, aiming to better reflect true LLM capabilities.
reputation: A popular open-ended LLM evaluation benchmark used by the community to reduce multiple-choice bias and better reflect real generation quality.
notes: Addresses selection bias and random guessing in MCQ by using open-style questions; includes code and dataset publicly available.
